description: Add a new component (by class path/name) to an actor as an instance component. Scene components attach to the actor's root, or become the root if it has none.

name.description: Optional component name. Auto-generated when omitted.

name: actor-component-add
title: Add Component

description: Remove a component (by name) from an actor.
name: actor-component-destroy
title: Destroy Component

description: Read a component's reflected properties, optionally scoped to the dotted 'paths' filter.

paths.description: Dotted property paths to include (scoped read).

name: actor-component-get
title: Get Component Data

description: List concrete (non-abstract) UActorComponent classes available to add, filtered by an optional name substring and paginated via offset/limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of classes to return. Defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of matching classes to skip. Defaults to 0.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against class names.

name: actor-component-list-all
title: List Component Classes

description: Write reflected properties on a component. Scene components additionally accept 'relativeLocation' {x,y,z}, 'relativeRotation' {pitch,yaw,roll}, and 'relativeScale3D' {x,y,z} routed to the relative-transform APIs.

properties.description: Property bag of name -> value to write.

name: actor-component-modify
title: Modify Component

description: Spawn a new actor in the current editor level from a native class path (e.g. '/Script/Engine.StaticMeshActor', 'PointLight') or a Blueprint asset path. Optionally set label, location, rotation, and a parent actor to attach to.

classPath.description: Native class or Blueprint asset path/name.

parentActor.description: Label/path of an actor to attach the new actor to.

name: actor-create
title: Create Actor

description: Remove an actor from the current editor level. Identify it by label, object name, or full path.

actor.description: Actor label / name / path to destroy.

name: actor-destroy
title: Destroy Actor

description: Duplicate an existing actor in the current level, optionally offsetting its location and assigning a new label.

actor.description: Actor label / name / path to duplicate.

name.description: Label for the duplicate. Auto-generated when omitted.

offset.description: World-space location offset {x,y,z} applied to the duplicate. Defaults to none.

name: actor-duplicate
title: Duplicate Actor

description: List actors in the current level filtered by label substring, path substring, and/or class. Optionally include each actor's reflected data, scoped to the dotted 'paths' filter to save tokens.

classFilter.description: Class path/name; matches actors of this class or a subclass.

labelFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against actor labels.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return. Defaults to 100.

pathFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against full actor paths.

paths.description: Dotted property paths to include per actor (scoped read).

name: actor-find
title: Find Actors

description: Write reflected properties on an actor. Transform keys 'location' {x,y,z}, 'rotation' {pitch,yaw,roll}, and 'scale' {x,y,z} are routed to the transform APIs; all other keys are set by name through FProperty reflection.

actor.description: Actor label / name / path to modify.

properties.description: Property bag of name -> value to write.

name: actor-modify
title: Modify Actor

description: Attach an actor to a parent actor (optionally at a named socket), or detach it when 'parent' is omitted/empty. World transform is preserved by default.

keepWorldTransform.description: Preserve the child's world transform across the (de)attach. Defaults to true.

parent.description: Parent actor label / name / path. Omit or leave empty to detach.

socket.description: Optional socket/bone name on the parent to attach to.

name: actor-set-parent
title: Set Actor Parent

description: Duplicate an asset to a new package path. 'source' and 'destination' use the §3.2 path-or-name convention; 'destination' is the full package path of the copy (e.g. '/Game/Mat/M_Foo_Copy'). Errors if 'destination' already exists.

destination.description: Destination package path for the duplicate.

name: asset-copy
title: Copy Asset

description: Create a Content Browser folder (directory) at the given package path, e.g. '/Game/MyNewFolder'. Must be under a project / plugin content root (not /Engine). Idempotent — succeeds if the folder already exists.

path.description: Package path of the folder to create, e.g. '/Game/MyFolder'.

name: asset-create-folder
title: Create Content Folder

description: Delete an asset by path-or-name (§3.2). Destructive and not undoable from MCP. By default refuses if other on-disk packages reference the asset (deleting would dangle those references); pass 'force':true to delete anyway.

force.description: Delete even when the asset is referenced by other packages. Default false.

name: asset-delete
title: Delete Asset

description: Query the Content Browser AssetRegistry with optional filters: 'name' (case-insensitive substring of the asset name), 'classPath' (full class path e.g. '/Script/Engine.Material', subclasses included), 'path' (package path to search under, e.g. '/Game/Materials'), 'tagKey'/'tagValue' (asset registry tag filter). When no 'path'/'classPath'/'tagKey' is given the search is scoped to '/Game' (not the whole registry incl. /Engine). Paginated via 'offset'/'limit' (limit is clamped to 1000).

name.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the asset name.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the result set. Default 0.

path.description: Package path to search under, e.g. '/Game/Materials'.

tagKey.description: Asset-registry tag name to filter on.

tagValue.description: Required value for 'tagKey' (omit to match any value). Requires 'tagKey'.

name: asset-find
title: Find Assets

description: Read AssetRegistry metadata for one asset by path-or-name (§3.2): name, object path, package, class, and the asset's registry tag map. Supports §3.2 scoped reads — pass 'paths' (dot-separated field names) to return only those branches of the result and save tokens.
name: asset-get-data
title: Get Asset Data

description: Import a source file (FBX, texture/PNG, etc.) from the local filesystem into the Content Browser via an AssetImportTask. 'file' is an absolute filesystem path; 'destination' is the target package path (e.g. '/Game/Imported', must be under a project / plugin content root, not /Engine); 'name' optionally overrides the imported asset name. Refuses to overwrite an existing asset at the destination unless 'replaceExisting':true. The import is in-memory unless 'save':true.

file.description: Absolute filesystem path of the source file to import.

replaceExisting.description: Overwrite an existing asset at the destination. Default false (re-import is opt-in).

save.description: Save the imported package(s) to disk. Default false (in-memory only).

name: asset-import
title: Import Asset

description: Create a UMaterialInstanceConstant from a parent material. 'parent' is the parent material/material-interface path-or-name; 'destination' is the full package path of the new instance (e.g. '/Game/Mat/MI_Foo').

destination.description: Destination package path for the new material instance.

name: asset-material-create
title: Create Material Instance

description: Read parameter info for a material or material instance (the 'shader' analog): scalar/vector/texture parameter names, plus current values (instance override or base-material default), plus the parent. Supports §3.2 scoped reads via 'paths'.
name: asset-material-get-data
title: Get Material Parameters

description: Set parameters on a UMaterialInstanceConstant. Pass 'scalars' (object of name->number), 'vectors' (object of name->{r,g,b,a}), and/or 'textures' (object of name->texture path-or-name). Changes are in-memory (the package is marked dirty); pass 'save':true to also write the package to disk.

save.description: Save the package to disk after applying. Default false (in-memory only).

name: asset-material-modify
title: Modify Material Instance

description: Move or rename an asset. 'source' and 'destination' use the §3.2 path-or-name convention; 'destination' is the full target package path. Errors if 'destination' already exists. Note: a move may leave a redirector at the old path (fix up references separately).
name: asset-move
title: Move / Rename Asset

description: Ask the AssetRegistry to rescan one or more package paths so newly added files on disk become visible. Pass 'paths' (array of package paths); defaults to ['/Game'] when omitted. 'force':true does a full blocking rescan on the game thread (slow for large trees) — leave false to rescan only modified files.

force.description: Force a full rescan (slow). Default false.

path.description: Single package path to rescan (alternative to 'paths').

name: asset-refresh
title: Refresh / Rescan Assets

description: Add a component to a Blueprint's Simple Construction Script (the public SCS surface). 'componentClass' is a UActorComponent subclass path or short name. Optionally attach under an existing scene-component node named by 'parentComponent'.

componentClass.description: UActorComponent subclass path or short name.

name.description: Variable name for the new component.

parentComponent.description: Optional existing scene-component node to attach under.

name: blueprint-add-component
title: Add Blueprint Component

description: Add an overridable parent event node (e.g. ReceiveBeginPlay, ReceiveTick) to the event graph via FKismetEditorUtilities::AddDefaultEventNode. 'name' is the parent UFunction name; it must be an overridable event on the parent class.
name: blueprint-add-event
title: Add Blueprint Event

description: Add a new user function graph (entry/result nodes auto-wired by the K2 schema) via FBlueprintEditorUtils::CreateNewGraph + AddFunctionGraph. Body authoring (free-form node wiring) is backlog; this creates the callable stub.
name: blueprint-add-function
title: Add Blueprint Function

description: Add a typed member variable via FBlueprintEditorUtils::AddMemberVariable using the §3.2 pin-type mapping. 'type' accepts a primitive (bool/int/int64/byte/float/string/name/text), a math struct (vector/vector2d/rotator/transform/color), or an object/struct path. Set 'isArray' for an array variable.

isArray.description: Wrap the type in an array. Defaults to false.

name: blueprint-add-variable
title: Add Blueprint Variable

description: Compile a Blueprint via FKismetEditorUtilities::CompileBlueprint and return a STRUCTURED error/warning list. Each message entry carries 'severity', 'message', and best-effort 'node'/'graph' context — this is the feedback loop an AI uses to self-correct.
name: blueprint-compile
title: Compile Blueprint

description: Create a new Blueprint class from a parent UClass path via the public FKismetEditorUtilities::CreateBlueprint. 'path' is the /Game package path for the asset (e.g. '/Game/MCP/BP_Thing'); the object-path form ('/Game/MCP/BP_Thing.BP_Thing') is also accepted and normalised. 'parentClass' is a native class path or short name (e.g. '/Script/Engine.Actor' or 'Actor'). The asset is registered in-session; saving to disk is out of scope for the MVP.

parentClass.description: Parent UClass path or short name. Defaults to Actor.

path.description: /Game package path for the new Blueprint asset (object-path form also accepted).

name: blueprint-create
title: Create Blueprint

description: Return a scoped graph summary of a Blueprint for LLM inspection: member variables (name/type/array), SCS components (name/class/parent), functions and events with node-counts, implemented interfaces, and the parent class chain.

path.description: Full object path of the Blueprint asset.

name: blueprint-get
title: Get Blueprint Summary

description: Rename and/or retype an existing member variable. Provide 'newName' to rename and/or 'newType' (with optional 'isArray') to change its pin type.

isArray.description: Array flag applied with 'newType'. Defaults to false.

name: blueprint-modify-variable
title: Modify Blueprint Variable

description: Remove a component node from a Blueprint's Simple Construction Script by variable name.

name.description: Variable name of the SCS component node to remove.

name: blueprint-remove-component
title: Remove Blueprint Component

description: Set a default property value on the Blueprint's Class Default Object (CDO). 'value' is parsed with the property's own text importer, so it accepts the same text format the editor uses (numbers, '(X=1,Y=2,Z=3)' for structs, asset paths for object refs). This changes the class default, so it affects newly-spawned instances only — not actors already placed in a level.
name: blueprint-set-default
title: Set Blueprint Default

description: Instance a Blueprint's generated Actor class into the current editor level — closing the create -> edit -> compile -> verify loop. Optionally set a world location and a label (spawn rotation is fixed at identity in the MVP).
name: blueprint-spawn
title: Spawn Blueprint

description: Clear the plugin's GLog ring buffer. Returns how many entries were dropped.
name: console-clear-logs
title: Clear Console Logs

description: Read recent engine log lines captured by the plugin's GLog ring buffer (capped at 10000). Filter by minimum severity ('Fatal'|'Error'|'Warning'|'Display'|'Log'|'Verbose'|'VeryVerbose'|'All'), exact category, and a message substring; 'limit' returns the most-recent N after filtering. Read-only.

limit.description: Max entries to return (most-recent first-trimmed); default 100, <=0 = all.

name: console-get-logs
title: Get Console Logs

description: Execute an Unreal console command (incl. CVars, e.g. 'stat fps', 'r.ScreenPercentage 80') via GEngine->Exec against the editor world, returning any captured output text.

command.description: The console command line to execute.

name: console-run-command
title: Run Console Command

description: Snapshot of the editor play state: whether Play-In-Editor is running, paused, or simulating, plus the current editor map. Read-only.
name: editor-application-get-state
title: Get Editor Application State

description: Drive Play-In-Editor: action = 'start' | 'stop' | 'pause' | 'resume'. PIE transitions are deferred to the next editor tick, so this returns a structured 'pending' result; poll editor-application-get-state to confirm the transition. Invalid transitions (e.g. pause while not playing) return a structured error.
name: editor-application-set-state
title: Set Editor Application State

description: List the actors currently selected in the editor, each as a §3.2 identity ref { name, label, class, path }. Read-only.
name: editor-selection-get
title: Get Editor Selection

description: Replace the editor's actor selection with the actors named by 'actors' (label / name / path refs, §3.2). Pass clear=true to deselect everything.

clear.description: Deselect all actors. When true, 'actors' is ignored.

name: editor-selection-set
title: Set Editor Selection

description: Create a new, empty level and make it the active editor world. Optionally seed it from an existing level via 'template' (asset path), and optionally persist it to disk via 'path' (asset path, e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena') — omit 'path' to leave the new level transient/in-memory. Replaces the current editor world (its undo buffer is reset, as with any New/Open Level).

path.description: Asset path to save the new level to (e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena'). Omit to leave it transient/in-memory.

template.description: Asset path of an existing level to seed the new one from. Omit for a blank level.

name: level-create
title: Create Level

description: Read an actor-tree snapshot of the loaded editor world. Returns each actor's identity, optionally including reflected data scoped to the dotted 'paths' filter (§3.2) to save tokens. Pass 'actor' to scope the read to a single actor instead of the whole world.

actor.description: Label / name / path of a single actor to read. Omit to snapshot the whole world.

limit.description: Maximum number of actors to return for a world snapshot. Defaults to 200; pass 0 or a negative value for no limit.

paths.description: Dotted property paths to include per actor (scoped read).

name: level-get-data
title: Get Level Data

description: List the levels loaded in the current editor world — the persistent level plus any streaming sublevels — with their load/visibility/current state, and whether the world is a World-Partition world. Read-only.
name: level-list-loaded
title: List Loaded Levels

description: Open an existing level as the active editor world, replacing the current one. Identify it by asset path (e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena').

path.description: Asset path of the level to open (e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena').

name: level-open
title: Open Level

description: Save the current editor level. Pass 'path' (asset path) to save-as a copy of the PERSISTENT level to a new location; omit it to save the current level (which may be a streaming sublevel) in place. A transient/never-saved level with no 'path' returns an error (provide 'path' to give it a location).

path.description: Asset path to save-as the PERSISTENT level to (e.g. '/Game/Maps/Arena'). Omit to save the current level in place.

name: level-save
title: Save Level

description: Set the current editing level (the one new actors are added to) by name — the content-browser short name of a loaded level (persistent or streaming sublevel). Use level-list-loaded to discover the available names.

name.description: Short name — or full package path, to disambiguate — of the loaded level to make current.

name: level-set-current
title: Set Current Level

description: Unload (remove from the world) a loaded streaming sublevel by its short name. The persistent level cannot be unloaded. Use level-list-loaded to discover the sublevel names.

name.description: Short name — or full package path, to disambiguate — of the streaming sublevel to unload.

name: level-unload-sublevel
title: Unload Sublevel

description: Read the reflected properties of any UObject resolved by object path ('/Game/Folder/Asset.Asset') or, for scene objects, by actor label. Optionally scoped to the dotted 'paths' filter.

paths.description: Dotted property paths to include (scoped read).

name: object-get-data
title: Get Object Data

description: Write reflected properties on any UObject resolved by object path or actor label. Transform keys are honored when the object is an actor or scene component.

properties.description: Property bag of name -> value to write.

name: object-modify
title: Modify Object

description: Invoke a UFunction by name. Provide EITHER 'target' (an object/actor ref, §3.2 — the function is resolved and called on it) OR 'class' (the function is called on that class's CDO — use for static/CallInEditor functions). 'args' is a JSON object mapping parameter names to values (§3.2). SAFETY: only BlueprintCallable or CallInEditor functions may be called; anything else is rejected — and the 'class' (CDO) path additionally requires static/CallInEditor (instance methods must use 'target'). ACCEPTED RISK: callable functions can still be destructive (QuitGame, console exec, DestroyActor), consistent with console-run-command. Returns the function's return value and any out-params.

class.description: Class ref whose CDO to call on (static/CallInEditor methods).

target.description: Object/actor ref to call the method on (instance methods).

name: reflection-method-call
title: Call Reflection Method

description: Discover UFunctions on a class (native class path, short name, or Blueprint asset/generated-class path, §3.2). Returns signatures: params (name/type), return type, and flags (static/instance, BlueprintCallable, pure, CallInEditor, callable). Optional 'name' filters by case-insensitive substring. Read-only.

class.description: Class ref to search (native path/name or Blueprint path).

limit.description: Max functions to return; default 100, <=0 = all.

name.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match the function name.

name: reflection-method-find
title: Find Reflection Method

description: Render the scene from a chosen camera actor (resolved by label/name/path) and capture it. Returns a base64 PNG as MCP image content. Optional 'width'/'height' are clamped to [1, 2048] per side; the default is 1024. Requires a GPU-backed (windowed) editor.

camera.description: Camera actor reference (label, object name, or path) to render from.

fov.description: Optional horizontal field-of-view override in degrees (clamped to [5, 170]); defaults to the camera component's FOV (or 90).

height.description: Optional output height in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); default 1024.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); default 1024.

name: screenshot-camera
title: Screenshot Camera

description: Capture the Play-In-Editor game view. Errors when no PIE session is active. Returns a base64 PNG as MCP image content. Optional 'width'/'height' are clamped to [1, 2048] per side; the default is 1024. Requires a GPU-backed (windowed) editor.

height.description: Optional output height in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); when only 'width' is given the height is derived from the native aspect ratio, and the native game-view height is used when both are omitted.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); when only 'height' is given the width is derived from the native aspect ratio, and the native game-view width is used when both are omitted.

name: screenshot-game-view
title: Screenshot Game View

description: Render a single actor in isolation against a neutral background, auto-framed by its bounds. Returns a base64 PNG as MCP image content. Optional 'width'/'height' are clamped to [1, 2048] per side; the default is 1024. Requires a GPU-backed (windowed) editor.

actor.description: Target actor reference (label, object name, or path) to render in isolation.

background.description: Optional background color as hex ('#RRGGBB' or '#RRGGBBAA'); the alpha of '#RRGGBBAA' is accepted but ignored (the PNG is always opaque). Defaults to dark grey.

fov.description: Optional field-of-view override in degrees (clamped to [5, 170]); default 50.

height.description: Optional output height in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); default 1024.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); default 1024.

name: screenshot-isolated
title: Screenshot Isolated Actor

description: Capture the active editor viewport. Note: while a Play-In-Editor session has viewport focus the 'active viewport' is the PIE game view; use screenshot-game-view to capture the game view explicitly. Returns a base64 PNG as MCP image content. Optional 'width'/'height' are clamped to [1, 2048] per side; the default is 1024. Requires a GPU-backed (windowed) editor.

height.description: Optional output height in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); when only 'width' is given the height is derived from the native aspect ratio, and the native viewport height is used when both are omitted.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels (clamped to [1, 2048]); when only 'height' is given the width is derived from the native aspect ratio, and the native viewport width is used when both are omitted.

name: screenshot-viewport
title: Screenshot Viewport

description: Compile the project's C++ and return a STRUCTURED diagnostic report — the AI feedback loop. Prefers Live Coding when the editor is interactive and Live Coding is active, otherwise invokes UnrealBuildTool on the project's Editor target ('target' overrides; default '<Project>Editor'). The result carries 'diagnostics' (an array of {file,line,severity,message}), 'errorCount'/'warningCount', the process 'returnCode', 'success' (returnCode==0) and 'compileClean' (zero compiler errors — true even when a running editor holds the module DLL so the link stage cannot relink it). Set 'useLiveCoding':false to force the UBT path.

platform.description: Build platform. Default the host platform (e.g. 'Win64').

useLiveCoding.description: Prefer Live Coding when available (interactive editor only). Default true.

name: source-compile
title: Compile Project C++

description: Scaffold a new C++ class — header + cpp generated from templates into Source/<module>/, mirroring the editor's 'New C++ Class'. 'className' is the bare name WITHOUT the U/A/F prefix (the prefix is derived from the parent). 'parentClass' is one of: UObject (default), Actor, ActorComponent, None (a plain non-UCLASS class). 'module' defaults to the project's primary module. Refuses to overwrite existing files unless 'force':true. All writes are JAILED to <Project>/Source.

className.description: Bare class name (no U/A/F prefix), e.g. 'MyActor'.

force.description: Overwrite existing header/cpp at the destination. Default false.

module.description: Target module folder under Source/. Defaults to the project's primary module.

parentClass.description: Parent kind: UObject (default), Actor, ActorComponent, or None.

name: source-create-class
title: Create C++ Class

description: Delete a source file. JAILED to <Project>/Source — refuses directories and any path outside the jail. Destructive and not undoable from MCP.

path.description: Source file path relative to <Project>/Source (or absolute, inside it).

name: source-delete
title: Delete Source File

description: Enumerate source files with their byte sizes. Scoped to 'module' (a folder under Source/) when given, else the whole <Project>/Source tree. 'recursive' (default true) walks sub-folders. By default lists .h/.cpp/.cs; pass 'extensions' (array of extensions without the dot) to override. JAILED to <Project>/Source.

extensions.description: Extensions to include (without the dot). Default ['h','cpp','cs'].

module.description: Module folder under Source/ to scope the listing. Omit for the whole tree.

name: source-list
title: List Source Files

description: Read a project C++/C# source file. 'path' is relative to the project Source/ directory (e.g. 'MyGame/MyActor.cpp') or an absolute path inside it; all access is JAILED to <Project>/Source. Optionally window the result by 1-based 'startLine'/'endLine' (inclusive). The returned text is byte-capped by 'maxBytes' (default 262144, hard cap 4194304); 'truncated' reports whether the cap clipped it.

endLine.description: 1-based last line to return (inclusive). Default: end of file.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of content to return (1..4194304). Default 262144.

path.description: Source file path relative to <Project>/Source (or absolute, inside it).

name: source-read
title: Read Source File

description: Replace an existing source file's full contents, or a 1-based inclusive line range. Pass 'content' (the replacement text). Omit 'startLine'/'endLine' to replace the whole file; pass both to splice 'content' over that line range. The file must already exist (use source-create-class for new files). JAILED to <Project>/Source.

path.description: Source file path relative to <Project>/Source (or absolute, inside it).

name: source-update
title: Update Source File
